notes.title: Celebrate Fest with Bot Crafter Demo!
notes.content:
We’ve been invited to another Steam event! This time Open World Survival Crafting Fest, because Bot Crafter is:
✅ Open World*
✅ Survival
✅ Crafting
✅ Game 

[b]The Fest starts on May 27 at 10:00 AM (PST) and lasts till June 3 10:00 AM (PST)[/b]

This Demo includes an enabled console, so it's a bit like a creative mode! Just press "~" to open it and discover a secret option for infinite resources (and more), so you can get creative and craft the hell out of Bots. It would be super cool if you could share screenshots of your creations on our Discord Server - [url=https://discord.gg/nyZNczCazG]https://discord.gg/nyZNczCazG[/url]


We’re still working on implementing the feedback you provided previously, but please feel free to give us plenty more.

notes.title: Bot Crafter Demo live during Dinos vs. Robots Fest!
notes.content:
Ready for a sneak peek into the future of space bots crafting? The first Bot Crafter demo is here, but only for a limited time during Dinos vs. Robots Fest

notes.title: It's Getting Dark
notes.content:
Hello, fellow machines enthusiasts! We've made some graphics improvements and would like to share the results. What do you think?

[b]Day and Night[/b]
We've dedicated some time to implementing a dynamic day and night cycle on our planet. You can truly feel that this world is alive, or at least used to be during its better times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/8ffa3124051e66f0e0d9ec398113022514a3c9f0.jpg[/img]
Make sure to attach headlights to your robot and add some lamps in your outpost, as when the nearby star dips below the horizon, it can get quite dark.


[b]Environment lifting[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/37ed010cd7fb06dc790251d2e8622b3b5d202c6e.jpg[/img]
We've made significant changes to the atmosphere of the Wetlands biome, giving it a more mossy and natural ambiance, as it should be.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/2f075f60b6ba61b1021f1c0ab0185674ed18534d.png[/img]
The Desert biome has also undergone significant enhancements, featuring more intricate details. The sand dunes now intertwine with the fossils of long-dead plants and dried pits of salt. Coupled with the day and night cycle, it offers much greater diversity, even for a desert.


Look forward next note. We'll be sharing some gameplay improvements.

notes.title: Operation: Desert Storm
notes.content:
Hey there! Let's dive right into new things:


[b]Desert biom[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/328975fd4333cf2988b7f997d4c2f57dbf212679.jpg[/img]
There's no sci-fi game without a proper desert. Dune has it, Star Wars has it, we have it! How do you like it?

[b]GUI changes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/a53756f3137434d9933af8614b975ffc400887fb.jpg[/img]
Now, bots are selected from the convenient wheel menu. You might recognize similar systems from other games, for example, when choosing weapons. We believe it's more intuitive than the previous numeric quick bar selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/8bcfbeba741f58dc825d079e19d4603ccb4fd77b.png[/img]
We've also revamped the Bot Panel - a dashboard where you can access all information about the current state of your robots. It's much clearer now.

Also, regarding the Damage System we mentioned in the previous update, check out our Twitter (oh sorry, it's "X" now) post with a video showcasing our most recent progress: https://twitter.com/botcraftergame/status/1687118484805967872

(Also leave a follow there... 🤖)

notes.title: Crash Tests: Break The Robots
notes.content:
Hey there! You already know that you can make robots in Bot Crafter. But did you know that you can also unmake them?

[b]Damage system[/b]
We are currently working on the bot damage system. Your robot can lose HP due to overheating, radiation, or banging its head against the wall (collisions), which, as you can see in the preview below, is being worked on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/7dce4ea1180d013a75ef76c104e926e6b10544b3.gif[/img]
Even though a destroyed bot breaks down into pieces, it can still have some usecase - the scrap that is left from it can be gathered and recycled, so some value will be retrieved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/8d9bfa7a94a21dd9828913d293571d09477f8d55.jpg[/img]
Crash enough of them and you get the junkyard all of a sudden.

[b]Biom retouch[/b]
The Wetlands biome has been retouched. Now it has a more greenish and mossy vibe compared to the previous iteration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197771/ebe2a114393d1b66b77d8fddbab504e32b6989fe.jpg[/img]

[b]That's it for today![/b]
Going back to work. See you around!

notes.title: Booting: Bot Systems
notes.content:
Hello there! Thanks for stopping by ːsteamthumbsupː

As you've probably noticed, we are making a game about robots. Why?

The first stage of the colonization of other planets will most likely be carried out by machines. Thanks to them, we are already conducting stunning research on Mars. Robots (rovers) like Curiosity, Perseverance, and Ingenuity are out there gathering data. We want to extend this idea of space bots operating on foreign planets and bring it to you to play with.


We will be regularly posting updates here about Bot Crafter's overall development progress, new features, insights, bloopers, and behind-the-scenes content to show off or get your thoughts on. So make sure to [u][b]wishlist and follow the game – it's really helpful to us![/b][/u] And for those who have already done that – thank you.


Now please advise: should the dude in the foreground of our key art wear a white or orange suit?
